name: Participation Collapse
definition: Eligible participants stop participating, leaving decisions to a small, self selected, or unrepresentative remainder.
trigger_conditions: Participation is unrewarded or costs more than it returns
Quorum is defined against eligible rather than active population

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: board independence contingent on who actually exercises the function

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F031 Participation Collapse. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F031
